            grid_points.append([x, y])

        y = 0.5 + radius * np.sin(angle)

        fib_points.append([x, y])

    hex_arrangement = []

    layers = [1, 2, 3, 4]  # Points per layer

            y = 0.5 + radius * np.sin(angle)

        y = 0.5 + radius * np.sin(angle)

        np.array(thomson_points),
        np.array(fib_points),
        np.array(hex_arrangement),
